title: 1. About Mahadum360
paragraphs: Mahadum360 is the first Nigerian language learning platform that brings online lessons and gamification together with in-person practice sessions with family at home and at school, connecting parents, teachers and family guides in one place to drive learning outcomes for children. "Mahadum" means university in Igbo, and that is what we bring you: a full learning space in your pocket. Learn to speak, read and understand Nigerian languages and English, Nigeria’s lingua franca, in short, easy lessons. Languages of Nigeria’s neighbouring countries and trade partners are planned for future releases. Learn today on our web app from any smartphone, tablet or computer. Our mobile app and SMS shortcode access are planned for future releases, so you will be able to learn from any phone, even without a smartphone or data. Learn at your own pace, anytime, anywhere. Mahadum360 has language learning all round.

Mahadum360 is a company registered in Nigeria with RC number 9601595, whose registered office is at 3rd Floor, 927/928 Bishop Aboyade Cole Street, Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria ("Mahadum360", "we", "us"). You can contact us at support@mahadum360.com.

title: 2. Using Mahadum360
paragraphs: These terms govern use of the Mahadum360 website, learning service and related features, including access by SMS, shortcode and other telco channels. By creating an account, purchasing a plan or using an organisation-provided account, either via a mobile application, using a short code service, or through the website (“Platform”, “App”), including any content, functionality and services offered (collectively, the "Services”), You agree to these terms and conditions, together with any documents expressly incorporated by reference .

Your access, registration, or use of Mahadum360 and its Services constitutes your consent to be bound by this Agreement and all other terms and policies that are applicable to any account or service you can access on Mahadum360 (collectively referred to as “Terms”). If you do not agree with the Terms by clicking the “I Accept” button or check box presented with these terms, then you will be unable to access the Services.

Current and future channels: Mahadum360 is currently available as a web app. These Terms apply to every way of accessing Mahadum360, now and in the future, including the web app, our mobile app and SMS and shortcode services (planned for future releases), and any other app, channel or service we release. Additional terms for a particular channel, such as mobile network operator terms for shortcode services or app store terms for the mobile app, will be shown when that channel becomes available and apply alongside these Terms.

We may change the Terms from time to time. This is solely at our discretion and changes will be effective when posted on Mahadum360, subject to the notice rules in ‘Notice of changes’ below. Please check the Terms regularly for updates as changes shall be effective immediately, and, we may indicate the date of such revision.

In addition, we may change, suspend or discontinue any aspect of the Services at any time, including the availability of any feature, or content. We may also impose limits on certain features and service or restrict your access to parts or all of Mahadum360 or the Services provided without liability. Where a change significantly affects how you access or navigate Mahadum360, we will give advance notice as set out in ‘Notice of changes’ below.
Your continuous use of Mahadum360, or any part of the Services constitutes your acceptance of the change and your consent to be bound to the new Terms of use.
Notice of changes

Changes without notice: we may make minor changes, and changes needed to protect security, at any time without notice. Examples include correcting typing or wording errors; fixing bugs; updating or adding lessons, audio, images or languages; adjusting colours, icons, layout or button labels; installing security updates; strengthening password, login or verification rules; blocking suspicious activity; and changes we must make urgently because of a law or regulator.

Changes with advance notice: we will give account holders at least 14 days’ notice, by email, in-app message or a notice on the website, before changes that significantly change how you access or navigate Mahadum360. Examples include moving to a new web address; changing how you sign in (for example, a new login method or required verification step); requiring a new app or shortcode to reach your account; changing how family accounts or learner profiles are set up, linked or accessed; a major redesign that moves core features such as lessons, the family dashboard, rewards or payments to a new place; removing a feature included in your paid plan; and changes to prices or billing, which will apply from your next billing period.

title: 3. Who can use the service
paragraphs: Every account must include an adult. Every Individual, Family and School account must be held or managed by at least one adult aged 18 or over. Only that adult can pay for services or enter a learner into competitions.

Learners under 18 use supervised profiles rather than independent logins. Only a parent or legal guardian can create the account, add the learner profile and generate the child's access code. Children cannot sign up themselves and cannot make payments. No one under 18 can be a stand-alone user. Every learner under 18 uses Mahadum360 only as a supervised learner profile inside a Family or School account, and cannot pay for any service or enter competitions; the adult account holder does this for them.

Learners aged 13 to 17 are minors and are not recognised as able to enter into legally binding contracts, so the rule above applies to them in full: they cannot open their own account and may join only as supervised learner profiles in a parent’s or legal guardian’s Family account or in a School account.

Age checks and control measures: at sign-up, every user must enter their date of birth. Anyone under 18 is stopped and directed to a parent or legal guardian, who must create a Family account, confirm parental consent and add the learner as a supervised learner profile. Learners under 18 enter their learning space only with an access code generated by the parent. Paid plans can be bought only by an adult account holder, and competition entries for learners under 18 must be approved from the linked adult account. We do not ask for identity documents at sign-up. We may ask any account holder for proof of age or identity when there is a reason to check, for example if someone tries to change a date of birth to make themselves 18 or over, if an account is reported or appears to belong to a child, or before a cash referral payout. We may suspend or close an account where age or identity information is false.
Learners aged 18 and over may create their own account and use all features.

Payments: only account holders aged 18 or older can buy a plan, top up a wallet or make any payment. Learners under 18 cannot make payments; paid plans for under-18s are bought by the linked parent or guardian.

Schools and organisation accounts may only be created by adults with authority to act for the organisation. Only schools duly registered with the appropriate authority may open a School account (see Section 10).
The parent, guardian or authorised organisation is responsible for creating and supervising each learner profile and for giving any required consent.

Parents remain responsible for supervision: we have built safeguards for learners under 18, including supervised profiles, parent-only payments, parent approval of rewards, private profiles and controls over who can review recordings and photos. No online service can remove every risk, so parents and guardians remain responsible for monitoring their child’s activity on Mahadum360, including time spent learning, the recordings and photos their child submits, and their child’s contact with family guides and teachers. Please report any concern to us promptly at support@mahadum360.com. Nothing in this clause limits our own responsibilities under applicable law.

title: 4. Accounts and learner profiles
paragraphs: Mahadum360 offers the following account types. Every account type must include at least one adult aged 18 or over, who is responsible for the account, payments and competition entries.
Individual user: one adult aged 18 or over who learns with one personal learner profile and is responsible for the account and all payments.

Family user: a household account held by at least one parent or legal guardian aged 18 or over, with up to 6 learner profiles for members of the family. Every family member under 18 uses a supervised learner profile. The adult account holder manages consent, payments, rewards and competition entries for every profile in the family.

School user: a school duly registered with the appropriate authority and holding a valid certificate of registration, acting through authorised adult administrators and teachers. A School account is used for students on the school’s roster, under the school’s agreement with us.
Institutions, such as universities, cultural organisations and government programmes, use accounts set up under a separate written agreement.

Account responsibilities: account holders must give accurate information, including date of birth, keep passwords and learner access codes secure, and tell us promptly about any unauthorised access. Account holders are responsible for activity on their account and on the learner profiles they manage, unless the law says otherwise.
Learning levels: each course is organised into levels, starting with Level 0, which is free. Level names, content and the number of levels may change as the curriculum grows.

title: 5. Learning access
paragraphs: The Free plan includes Level 0 in each language. Paid card and bank plans unlock all lessons; airtime subscriptions include Level 1 only. The Free plan may include usage limits, such as hearts that pause lessons and quizzes for a period when they run out. Paid plans remove these limits. How the limits work is explained in the app and in our FAQ, and may change from time to time.
The Free plan is supported by age-appropriate adverts. Adverts shown to learners under 18 are not personalised. Paid plans are ad-free.
Courses, language availability, lesson order and features may change as content is corrected, improved or expanded. We aim to communicate material service changes appropriately.

title: 6. Acceptable use
paragraphs: Use the service for lawful learning, teaching, family and programme purposes.
Do not harass, exploit, impersonate or endanger another person.
Do not attempt to bypass access controls, probe security or interfere with service operation.
Do not upload unlawful, abusive, infringing or malicious material.
Do not scrape, resell or reproduce protected content except where a written agreement permits it.
Do not manipulate rewards, competitions, referrals, payments or reporting.
Do not share a child's access code with anyone outside the family or authorised school.
Do not upload photos or recordings of other people without their permission. For chore evidence, photograph the task, not the child.

title: 7. Plans, payments and cancellation
paragraphs: Prices, billing frequency, included features and applicable taxes are shown before purchase or set out in an organisation agreement. Card and bank payments are processed securely by licensed payment service providers. Their terms also apply to how they process your payment.

Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period until cancelled. You may cancel a card or bank plan at any time in your account or by contacting us. Access continues until the end of the paid billing period.

Airtime subscriptions are billed through your mobile network at the prevailing rate shown to you before you opt in. Rates may change, and we will tell you before a change applies to your subscription. You can cancel at any time by sending STOP to the shortcode shown in your subscription confirmation message, or by following your mobile network’s opt-out instructions. Network operator terms also apply.
No refunds on lessons and subscriptions

Start your learning journey and build basic language skills at no cost with Level 0 in every language. Only commit to a paid plan when you are satisfied. Because you can try before you pay, all payments for lessons, subscriptions, coins, streak shields and other in-app items are final and non-refundable. We do not give refunds or partial refunds for change of mind, unused time or lessons, cancelling part-way through a billing period, a renewal that was not cancelled in time, learning results, or accounts suspended for breaking these terms. Cancelling stops future payments only.
When we will correct a charge

We will investigate and reverse or credit a confirmed: duplicate charge; wrong amount or wrong plan; charge after a valid cancellation (including airtime charges after STOP); unauthorised transaction; or long outage of paid features caused by us. Email us with the subject "Billing error" within 30 days of the charge, with the date, amount and payment reference (never your full card number or PIN). We reply within 5 working days. Please contact us before raising a chargeback. If a chargeback is raised for a valid payment, paid access may be suspended.
Customers outside Nigeria

If your local law gives you a right to cancel digital content (such as the 14-day right in the UK and EU), you agree at checkout that access starts immediately and acknowledge that you lose that right once access begins, except where your law does not allow this.

title: 8. Data top-ups
paragraphs: Mobile data bundles bought on Mahadum360 are supplied by your mobile network through our licensed partners. The Data Top-Up Terms explain delivery, failed top-ups and refunds for data purchases. Data top-ups are separate from learning subscriptions.

title: 9. Coins, rewards, referrals and competitions
paragraphs: Coins, XP, badges, hearts, streak shields and similar learning rewards are platform features, not cash or stored value, unless a specific promotion clearly states otherwise. They cannot be exchanged for money and are lost if the account is closed. Chore coins are released only after parent approval.
Referral programme. Every account holder receives a unique referral code. You can share your code with people outside your own family or school group.

You earn only after a purchase. You do not earn anything for sharing your code, sending invitations, or for someone signing up or using the Free plan. You earn a referral reward only when a person signs up with your code and makes a qualifying paid purchase on Mahadum360.

How much you earn: you earn a percentage, shown on your Refer & earn page or stated in your contract or organisation agreement, of the referred person’s first qualifying subscription payment (monthly or annual). Renewals, later purchases, data top-ups and coins do not earn a further reward.

School referral rewards (first enrolment only): for schools, the qualifying payment is the school’s first paid enrolment invoice (registration and student fees for the first academic year, excluding VAT). Enrolment for later academic years is a renewal on the same school account (for example, “Re-enrolment 2027/28”) and does not earn a further reward. Closing and reopening a school, or re-registering it under a new name, does not restart the reward. Ongoing school engagement is handled by a separate school programme, not by referral rewards.
Schools and teachers do not earn referral rewards on students registered on their own roster, or on those students’ purchases.
Parents and guardians do not earn referral rewards on their own children or on members of their own family account. They do earn on people they refer from outside their family group.
No self-referrals: you cannot earn by referring yourself, a second account you control, or accounts created to collect rewards.

Holding period and payout: rewards are held for 14 days after the qualifying purchase before they clear. The minimum payout is ₦5,000. Cash payouts are made only to verified account holders aged 18 or older, to an account in their own name.
Reversals: a reward is cancelled or reduced if the qualifying payment is reversed, charged back, corrected as a billing error or found to be fraudulent.

Fair sharing: do not spam, make false or misleading claims about Mahadum360, or pretend to speak for us. We may suspend referral earnings, cancel uncleared rewards and close referral access for fraud or misuse.
Taxes: you are responsible for any tax that applies to your referral earnings.
Changes: we may change or end the referral programme. Rewards that have already cleared will still be paid.

Competitions will be announced on Mahadum360 from time to time. The terms and conditions for each competition, including who can enter, entry dates, judging and prizes, will be announced with that competition and apply alongside these terms.

Learners under 18 may enter competitions only through an account linked to a parent or guardian, who must approve the entry and receives any prize on the learner's behalf. Competition or promotional rules may add eligibility, timing, judging, prize and conduct terms. Those specific rules apply alongside these terms.

title: 10. Educators, schools and institutions
paragraphs: Organisation administrators control authorised seats, roles, rosters and programme access. A separate order, proposal or service agreement may define pricing, term, data responsibilities, support and programme requirements. Schools must have a lawful basis, including parental consent where required, before adding learners.

School registration: only schools duly registered with the appropriate authority may open a School account. A school must provide its certificate of registration when we ask for it, which may be at sign-up or at any later time. We may suspend or close a School account if valid proof of registration is not provided.

Teachers: every teacher added to a School account must be a genuine teacher employed or engaged by that school. The school confirms this when it adds a teacher and is responsible for its teachers’ conduct on the platform.
Where an organisation supplies or controls an account, its authorised administrators may access information and learning activity according to their role and the applicable agreement.

title: 11. Language practice guides
paragraphs: A language practice guide is a person invited onto Mahadum360 to help a learner practise a language. Guides are either:
family members (such as grandparents, aunts, uncles or older cousins) chosen and invited by a parent or guardian; or
teachers employed or engaged by a registered school, who use the platform through that school.

Mahadum360 does not employ, recruit, interview, background-check, endorse or supervise language practice guides, and does not guarantee their conduct, qualifications or the accuracy of what they teach.

Parents and guardians are solely responsible for choosing and interviewing any family member they invite as a guide, for deciding whether that person is suitable to interact with their child, and for supervising their child's practice with them.
Schools and institutions are solely responsible for recruiting, vetting and supervising the teachers they add to the platform, in line with their own safeguarding duties.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Mahadum360 bears no responsibility or liability for the acts, omissions, conduct or teaching of any language practice guide, or for any loss, harm or dispute arising from a learner's or family's dealings with one, including contact that takes place outside the platform (for example by phone, WhatsApp or in person).

We strongly recommend that a parent or trusted adult is present or nearby during practice with children, and that children never share personal details, photos or locations with a guide. Parents can remove a guide from the family circle at any time. If you have a safety concern, report it to us at support@mahadum360.com and, where needed, to the police.

paragraphs: Mahadum360 and its licensors retain rights in the platform, curriculum, audio, video, artwork, software and brand materials. We grant users a limited, revocable, non-transferable right to use the service for personal, family or authorised programme learning.

You retain rights in content you submit, including speaking recordings and photos. You give us the limited permission needed to host, process and display it for service delivery, safety, support and the authorised learning relationship. We do not use a child's recordings or photos for marketing.

title: 13. Third-party services
paragraphs: Some features rely on third parties, such as payment providers, mobile networks, and messaging services like WhatsApp or SMS. We are not responsible for their services, outages or terms, which apply when you use them.

title: 14. Suspension, changes and responsibility
paragraphs: We may restrict or suspend access where reasonably necessary for safety, security, non-payment, legal compliance or serious breach of these terms. Where appropriate, we will provide notice and a way to contact us. You may close your account at any time by contacting us.

We work to keep the service available and accurate, but online services can experience interruptions and learning outcomes vary. Lessons reflect standard forms of each language, and regional dialects and usage may differ.

paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, Mahadum360 is not liable for indirect or consequential loss, or for loss of data, profit or opportunity. Our total liability to you in any 12-month period is limited to the amount you paid us in that period. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability that cannot legally be excluded, including rights under the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act 2018.

title: 16. Governing law and disputes
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, while preserving mandatory consumer and privacy rights that may apply where a user lives. If a dispute arises, please contact us first, and we will try to resolve it within 30 days. If it is not resolved, either party may refer it to mediation at the Lagos Multi-Door Courthouse, and then to the courts of Lagos State. Organisation agreements may specify additional governing-law and dispute terms.

title: 17. Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update these terms when the service or legal requirements change. The current version and update date will remain available on this page. For changes that significantly affect how you access or navigate Mahadum360, we will notify account holders in advance, as set out in ‘Notice of changes’ in Section 2.
Questions about these terms can be sent to support@mahadum360.com.
